commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; echo "RUN_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_ID"; git status --porcelain; git branch --show-current

WP_BRANCH="issue-1512-a-shadow-pass-narrower-than-the-expected-roster-20260825"
PR_JSON=$(gh pr list --head "$WP_BRANCH" --state open --json number,headRefName,createdAt,closingIssuesReferences,isCrossRepository) || PR_JSON=''
echo "PR_JSON(head): $PR_JSON"
if [ "$PR_JSON" = "[]" ] || [ -z "$PR_JSON" ]; then
  PR_JSON2=$(gh pr list --search "1512 in:body" --state open --json number,headRefName,createdAt,closingIssuesReferences,isCrossRepository) || PR_JSON2=''
  echo "PR_JSON(body): $PR_JSON2"
f …[per-command-truncated]

HEAD_REF="issue-1512-a-shadow-pass-narrower-than-the-expected-roster-20260825"
CO_ERR=$( { git fetch origin "$HEAD_REF" && git checkout "$HEAD_REF"; } 2>&1 1>/dev/null ) || true
echo "CO_ERR=$CO_ERR"
LANDED=no; [ -n "$HEAD_REF" ] && [ "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = "$HEAD_REF" ] && LANDED=yes
echo "LANDED=$LANDED"
git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD

RUN_URL="https://github.com/The01Geek/prflow/actions/runs/32884747523"
PR_NUMBER=1945
if ! PR_BODY=$(gh api "repos/The01Geek/prflow/pulls/1945" --jq '.body' 2>/dev/null); then
  echo "READ_FAILED"
else
  echo "$PR_BODY" | grep -o '\[View run\]([^)]*)' | head -5
fi
